basic_info.description: This stunning 3BD/2BA home pairs a quintessential Victorian facade with a sleek, light-filled interior perfectly designed for modern city living. Fully reimagined in a 2019 to-the-studs remodel, it features soaring 10' ceilings, wide-plank hardwood floors, built-in sound, and thoughtful, high-end upgrades throughout. The open-concept layout flows into a chef's kitchen with Fisher & Paykel appliances, custom cabinetry, abundant counter space, and a generous breakfast bar ideal for hosting or busy mornings. The spacious primary suite includes a walk-through closet and spa-inspired bath with double vanity, Toto washlet, and walk-in rain shower. Two additional bedrooms offer flexibility for a home office, guest room, or nursery. Outside, enjoy exclusive use of a private half of the lush backyard complete with built-in gas grill, fire pit, and lounge space, thoughtfully separated from the neighboring unit's yard. In-unit laundry, leased parking a block away, bike storage in the garage and a dedicated storage unit, and a 98 Walk Score put the best of the Inner Mission just outside your door.
